full_judgment: 2. The prosecution case, in short, is that on 26-12-2016, one Md Mosharraf Hossain Mridha, Deputy Director, Anti-Corruption Commission, Integrated District Office, Chittagong lodged a First Information Report (FIR) with Halishahar Police Station against the accused-petitioner and five others stating, inter alia, that the accused-petitioner in connivance with each other and upon misusing their power and position and also with a view to gain money illegally, misappropriated 2 L/C loans amounting to Taka 135,80,40,208.14 only upon taking a few cheque and Trust Receipt as security; that the former Managing Director by getting L/C advice from branch orally directed the Branch Manager to open L/C without taking prior approval of Board of Directors, only having passed or approved by Executive Committee of Southeast Bank Limited; that upon inquiry on submitted documents of L/C matter on account of M/s Rising Steel Limited, it is found out that M/s Rising Steel Ltd imported 4(four) vessels opening 4(four) L/C during 2008 to 2012; that M/s Rising Steel Limited opened 1st L/C to import vessel on 30-9-2008 for Taka 45,84,81,144.60 by paying 10% down payment, but without paying the said L/C money applied on 21-12-2009 for another L/C to import vessel amounting Taka 53.03 Crore; therefore without taking any step to realize the 1st L/C money, the Branch sent L/C loan application to Head Office of the bank and in the meantime, having oral direction of former Managing Director, on 27-12-2009 Branch Manager sent a letter to AD branch to open L/C; that the Branch got the said approval letter on 6-1-2010 and by this time, the client paid 1st L/C due bill but the 2nd L/C due amount Taka 51,52,78,474.85 being unpaid, M/s Rising Steel Ltd applied for another L/C on 05-4-2010 to import vessel MT RIVER amounting Taka 93,40,70,699.89 and in this time also, the former Managing Director Mr Mahbubul Alam orally directed the branch Manager to send a letter on 6-4-2010 to AD branch to open L/C and on the same day, AD branch opened the said L/C; that in the mean time, the client adjusted due bill of 2009 on 13-4-2011; that despite due bill of 2010 amounting to Taka 44,32,47,100.26, on 23-8-2012, the client again applied to open L/C for Taka 72.89 Crore and the same was opened on 28-8-2012; that in the case of all the applications for opening L/C(s), the former Managing Director Mahbubul Alam orally approved and directed branch manager to open L/C(s) without prior approval of Board of Directors having only passed or approved by the Executive committee and by doing this, the accused persons in connivance with each other practicing fraud and forgery and misusing their power and position with a view to illegally gain money misappropriated Taka 135,80,40,288.14 and committed criminal offences under sections 409/420/109 of the Penal Code, 1860 read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947. Hence the FIR.
